claim: A Region has a default of 20 gateway VPC endpoints, the quota is adjustable, and you can create up to 255 gateway endpoints per VPC.
question: How many gateway VPC endpoints can you have per Region and per VPC?

values.display: up to 255 gateway endpoints per VPC
values.spoken: up to two hundred fifty-five gateway endpoints per VPC

qualifiers.condition: up to 255 gateway endpoints per VPC
